title: GitStore Collection
description: YAML frontmatter for a GitStore Collection resource. A Collection resource is a Markdown file: this schema validates only the frontmatter object between the opening and closing '---' delimiters. The remaining Markdown content is the free-form collection description body and is not covered by this schema. A Collection groups Products either dynamically (spec.selector, matched by label) or manually (spec.targetRef, a single explicit Product). See docs/collections/collection-spec.md for the full authoring contract.

ObjectMeta.description: Author-writable resource metadata. Do not set uid, resourceVersion, generation, creationTimestamp, revision, ownerReferences, or finalizers — those fields are system-managed and any of them present in an authored file causes the push to be rejected.

name.description: DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, 1-63 characters, no leading/trailing hyphen. Identifies this Collection uniquely within its namespace.

namespace.description: Optional. When omitted, the namespace is inferred from the owning repository at push time. When present, it is validated to match the inferred namespace.

labels.description: Optional key/value labels. Keys may use an optional "prefix/name" form; prefix ≤ 253 chars, name segment ≤ 63 chars. Values ≤ 63 chars.

annotations.description: Optional key/value annotations. No length restriction.

ObjectReference.description: A pointer to another catalogue resource.

name.description: Required. Name of the referenced resource.

FileReference.description: Identifies a File resource by name and kind.

name.description: Required — the name of the referenced File resource, even when optional is true.

optional.description: When true, admission succeeds even if the referenced File is absent.

MediaDefinition.description: A media slot referencing a File resource.

key.description: Required. Label key to match against.

values.description: Required and must be non-empty when operator is "In" or "NotIn"; must be omitted/empty for "Exists"/"DoesNotExist".

LabelSelector.description: Selects Products dynamically by label. matchLabels entries are ANDed together with matchExpressions entries.

CollectionSpec.description: Author-controlled declarative specification for a collection. Use exactly one of selector (dynamic) or targetRef (manual, single Product) — using both or neither may be rejected depending on the collection's intended semantics.

title.description: Required. Human-readable display title. Max 200 characters.

selector.description: Dynamic membership: Products matching this label selector belong to the collection.

targetRef.description: Manual membership: a single explicit reference. kind must be "Product" when present.
